release_review.summary: Install the signature verifier in each hosted Desktop packaging job and preserve bundle staging cleanup on Linux shell failures. Product behavior, Runtime Service payloads and compatibility epoch 34 remain unchanged.
release_review.same_window_rationale: Compared with v0.13.1, this patch installs the existing pinned Cosign action in the Desktop release job and captures the exact temporary cleanup path before Bash unwinds local variables. It adds source-only workflow coverage, cross-platform failure-path regression coverage, release review metadata and generated knowledge artifacts. It does not change Runtime Service payloads, authorization, storage schemas, Desktop bridge contracts, startup reports or SSH bootstrap. The existing protocol, epoch 34 and minimum versions remain the correct compatibility boundary. All v0.13.1 Runtime builds succeeded, but Desktop packaging failed because its clean runners lacked Cosign; no GitHub Release was published and its immutable tag is retained.
